Heat in Dhaka

Dhaka

One of the world’s densest cities, where heat fills tin-roofed homes.

What heat does here

250 million

workdays lost to heat-related illness in Bangladesh in 2024, worth up to US$1.78 billion.

What is in place

A city official for heat

In 2023, Dhaka North City Corporation appointed Asia’s first Chief Heat Officer: one role whose job is heat.

What helps

Cooler roofs and paid rest protect both health and income.

Sources: One Billion Resilient, 2023; workday estimate cited on the Dhaka page.
